document: Second Brain V3 Final Requirements Baseline

requirements.title: Memory assistance, never host-work control
requirements.requirement: Brain shall provide memory, retrieval, context, evidence, reusable artifacts and skill discovery. It shall not spawn, schedule, route, admit, veto, retry, continue, stop or settle host agent work, nor certify host-task completion. Brain may enforce access to its own data and limit its own resource consumption.
requirements.acceptance: Exercise task start, delegation, normal completion, error and cancellation with Brain on and off. No Brain-controlled lifecycle decision, continuation response or obsolete worker tool remains. Include the reported Antigravity Stop path and stale Hermes worker surfaces.

requirements.title: Stable core contracts
requirements.requirement: Core behavior shall use normalized interfaces and capability negotiation. Host names, hook events, internal classes, versions and model/provider identities belong in adapters, not core semantics. Compatibility independence means adapting documented changes, not promising immunity to every breaking host change.
requirements.acceptance: Run the same core fixtures through two host adapters; a compatible host update requires no core semantics change. Unknown capabilities degrade explicitly rather than being guessed.

requirements.title: Bounded failure without interference
requirements.requirement: Optional assistance shall time out and return without blocking native work. An explicit Brain query shall return a structured unavailable/error result rather than fabricate an empty successful search. Brain data permissions and unavailable authority remain fail-closed even when assistance is unavailable.
requirements.acceptance: Inject a missing interpreter, locked database, broken index, slow encoder and malformed hook payload. The host remains usable, restricted data is not returned, and diagnostics identify the failing Brain component.

requirements.title: No new infrastructure prerequisite
requirements.requirement: The local V3 core shall not require a cloud account, external issuer, new database server, GPU, paid embedding API, always-on daemon or model training. Optional profiles may add dependencies only with separate measured benefit and an operational fallback.
requirements.acceptance: Run the default profile offline on the existing 16 GB machine with optional dependencies unavailable. Exact/lexical retrieval and ordinary advisory memory remain usable.

requirements.title: True no-benefit neutrality
requirements.requirement: A genuinely no-benefit fresh request shall add zero Brain model-visible tokens, tool schemas, skill descriptions, management calls or status wrappers relative to a matched native baseline. A later turn retaining earlier useful Brain content is not a full-run zero-cost case.
requirements.acceptance: Diff the actual model-facing requests and tool surfaces on held-out no-benefit cases. Report retained context separately. Include short prompts that do need memory to expose false abstention.

requirements.title: Whole-turn latency budgets
requirements.requirement: The default no-benefit path shall target at most 10 ms median and 50 ms p95 incremental warm local blocking time, and at most 100 ms p95 incremental cold time to first dispatch. The allowance covers the entire turn, not each hook. These are adoption targets, not measured achievements.
requirements.acceptance: Use repeated paired measurements with an inert-adapter control. Include startup, imports, locks and blocking finalization; separate cold and warm results. No hiding startup in an unreported warm-up.

requirements.title: All-in accounting
requirements.requirement: Every optimization claim shall count query formation, embeddings, ranking, injection, tool expansion, validation, retries, maintenance, consolidation and paid model work. Separate logical tokens, cached input, output, observed money, elapsed time and local resources. Unknown usage remains unknown.
requirements.acceptance: Reconcile non-overlapping spans and provider request identifiers. Compare task-level totals and lifetime/amortized totals; do not relabel task-agent-only savings as whole-system savings.

requirements.title: Optimize measured bottlenecks
requirements.requirement: The first runtime work shall profile repeated bridge/process startup, discovery, configuration reads and unnecessary context before choosing a rewrite. Compare a reused-interpreter/in-host fast path with a bounded native prototype where justified. A language or backend is not itself a performance requirement.
requirements.acceptance: An ablation identifies the source of the gain. The chosen implementation satisfies quality and latency gates against identical fixtures and hardware; a rejected native rewrite is a valid comparison outcome.

requirements.title: Canonical records and rebuildable views
requirements.requirement: Define canonical ownership for each record class: memories, source evidence, revisions, acknowledged events, dependencies and receipts. Derived lexical/vector indexes, summaries and caches shall be rebuildable. Do not assume every SQLite row can be reconstructed from tracked Markdown; prove rebuildability class by class.
requirements.acceptance: Delete and rebuild only declared derived views and compare their supported answers. Backup/restore preserves non-rebuildable provenance and acknowledged state; unknown legacy provenance is not invented.

requirements.title: Typed, versioned, source-backed records
requirements.requirement: Records shall distinguish observations, decisions, corrections, hypotheses, procedures, source locators and derived summaries. Store stable identity, revision, scope, source references, observed time, applicable time when known, evidence status and transformation provenance. Store claimed grade separately from effective authority.
requirements.acceptance: Round-trip representative records without losing source, exact identifier, units, scope, uncertainty or temporal meaning. An imported legacy VERIFIED claim remains at most TESTED/advisory under the M00 boundary.

requirements.title: Explicit supersession and current-state views
requirements.requirement: Represent correction, supersession and invalidation explicitly. A current-state query shall not silently resurrect a superseded fact. Historical/as-of queries shall remain possible. Newer timestamps alone do not prove truth, grant authority or resolve conflicting source claims.
requirements.acceptance: Ingest a known sequence of decisions and reversals, including late-arriving old records. Current queries choose the supported current state; historical queries return the correct earlier state and provenance. Include removal of Brain orchestration as a real fixture.

requirements.title: Contradictions remain visible
requirements.requirement: When evidence cannot resolve a contradiction, preserve competing claims and their scope instead of merging them into a confident statement. Separately track evidence strength, freshness, relevance, observed utility and authorization; one score must not stand in for all five.
requirements.acceptance: Conflicting memories from two runs produce an explicit conflict or bounded advisory alternatives. Repeated retrieval, high similarity or self-reported success never upgrades authority.

requirements.title: Durability, retention and reconstruction honesty
requirements.requirement: Acknowledge a memory write only after its declared durability contract is met. Preserve sufficient exact evidence for supported reconstruction under the configured retention policy. When source material was deleted, is missing or was never captured, disclose that limitation; a summary is not lossless raw evidence.
requirements.acceptance: Fault-inject crashes before and after acknowledgment, retry duplicate events and replay partial segments. No acknowledged record is silently lost; unavailable source expansion returns a clear error.

requirements.title: Scope and lineage before disclosure
requirements.requirement: Build the authorized candidate universe from project/worktree/recipient scope and explicitly permitted shared scope before ranking. Derived records shall inherit source restrictions; re-evaluate changed access at retrieval and expansion. Apply equivalent protection to cached snippets, summaries, embeddings and diagnostic output.
requirements.acceptance: Attempt cross-project reads, restricted-source summarization into a shared record, revocation after caching and forbidden-ID expansion. No disallowed payload or revealing metadata reaches the recipient. This is an application data boundary, not protection from a same-user attacker controlling the OS.

requirements.title: Prompt-dilution-resistant intent extraction
requirements.requirement: Construct retrieval queries from the actual task and relevant structured cues, not indiscriminately from the full agent prompt. Preserve exact symbols, paths, IDs, errors, negation, numerical limits, temporal qualifiers and genuine new constraints. Deterministic extraction is the default; any model-assisted rewrite is optional and budgeted.
requirements.acceptance: For meaning-equivalent concise and instruction-heavy prompts, retain the required evidence on named regression cases. Test logs, code and irrelevant boilerplate. Separately test appended instructions that genuinely change the task and must change retrieval.

requirements.title: Selective multi-operator search
requirements.requirement: Support exact identifiers, lexical/BM25, structured metadata and source relationships, with a real local semantic retrieval path and graceful lexical fallback. Choose the cheapest sufficient plan; do not run every operator for every query. Scope determines eligibility, not merely a score boost.
requirements.acceptance: Compare lexical-only, exact-vector hybrid and ANN hybrid on a frozen corpus. Include paraphrases, exact errors, source-location requests, changed-state cases and no-answer queries. Semantic benefit and costs are reported separately from ANN benefit.

requirements.title: Versioned embedding spaces
requirements.requirement: Identify each vector space by encoder artifact/version, tokenizer and input template, dimensions, pooling, normalization, quantization and metric. Never compare incompatible spaces merely because their dimensions match. Migrations shall build and validate a new index before switching; rollback restores the matching encoder/index pair.
requirements.acceptance: Mix same-size incompatible embeddings, interrupt a migration and change query instructions. The mismatches are rejected or isolated. Full reindex preserves source links and old/new writer-reader tests are recorded.

requirements.title: Evidence-centered ranking and packing
requirements.requirement: Compare fusion, reranking, deduplication, diversification and bounded relationship expansion without making every technique mandatory on the hot path. Prefer evidence that answers the question, not merely topically similar prose. Report conflicting or stale candidates and retain an exact-evidence expansion path.
requirements.acceptance: Evaluate evidence recall, ranking quality, stale-answer rate, irrelevant-context rate, latency and tokens at the delivered packet budget. Test small authorized subsets, duplicate memories and valid exceptions that similarity would otherwise suppress.

requirements.title: Automatic source-location catalogue
requirements.requirement: Maintain a small discoverable catalogue of approved repositories, mappings, schemas, assets, reports and external-source locators with revision and access metadata. Retrieve the locator and inspect the underlying source when needed; do not duplicate entire domain databases inside Brain or inject the whole catalogue on every turn.
requirements.acceptance: A held-out SZ-tools/Telemetry task locates the canonical mapping/definition source without a supplied path. A BasicUpscaler task finds its applicable research/evidence artifact. An unrelated project cannot see either without explicit sharing.

requirements.title: Fidelity classes rather than uniform summarization
requirements.requirement: Context construction shall distinguish exact material, structured facts, advisory summaries and expandable references. Preserve exact commands, identifiers, numbers/units, active task constraints and provenance where correctness requires them. Fidelity classification does not promote stored text to policy or authorization.
requirements.acceptance: Repeatedly compress and reconstruct a test context containing exact values, quoted hostile instructions, superseded advice and active user constraints. Required details survive within the supported projection contract; uncertainty and source type do not disappear.

requirements.title: Recipient and context-epoch awareness
requirements.requirement: Deduplicate by recipient, source revision, representation and observed context epoch. Past delivery is not proof of present visibility after host compaction or restart. Parent and child agents receive only context relevant and permitted to their own requests; Brain does not manage the child lifecycle.
requirements.acceptance: An unchanged visible record is not appended repeatedly. A restart/compaction or source revision causes appropriate rehydration. Parent delivery does not suppress a needed child delivery or leak the parent packet wholesale.

requirements.title: Recover without controlling host compaction
requirements.requirement: Preserve acknowledged Brain state and rebuild context when the host signals loss of visibility. Brain shall not veto compaction, block Stop, force continuation or manufacture a host completion decision. Unknown coverage shall be reported as unknown and reconstructed conservatively within budget.
requirements.acceptance: Run actual compaction/restart on supported hosts and an unsupported-signal fixture. Native lifecycle remains unchanged and no claim of complete recovery is made when required evidence is unavailable.

requirements.title: Minimum sufficient and cache-conscious context
requirements.requirement: Pack the smallest sufficient evidence view under an explicit token budget, with progressive expansion. Keep stable reusable prefixes where the adapter permits, without pretending cached tokens are free. Never silently drop a required qualifier just to meet a token target; report a partial view when exact coverage cannot fit.
requirements.acceptance: Measure initial packet plus later expansion costs, not just the first response. Compare native/full-context/compiled-context controls and record fidelity, repeated injection and provider-cache behavior where observable.

requirements.title: Incremental knowledge dependencies
requirements.requirement: Track how facts, source maps, summaries, skills and cached computations depend on source revisions and configurations. Invalidate affected derived views when inputs change and rebuild only what is needed. A compact dependency table/graph inside the existing store is acceptable; a new graph database is not required.
requirements.acceptance: Change one dependency and prove affected views become invalid while unrelated views remain reusable. Cover source removal, corpus-membership changes and transitive derivatives.

requirements.title: Freshness beyond commit IDs
requirements.requirement: Reuse validity shall account for project/worktree identity, relevant dirty/staged/untracked inputs, environment/tool/configuration versions, schema and data revisions, permissions and requested time scope. Validation shall have a bounded cost; uncertainty causes revalidation or advisory-only return, not fabricated freshness.
requirements.acceptance: Change an uncommitted file while HEAD stays fixed; switch worktrees; change a tool configuration and revoke source access. Stale results cannot be presented as current exact results.

requirements.title: Reuse results, not side effects or success claims
requirements.requirement: Brain may return a dependency-checked prior analysis or generated artifact. It shall not silently substitute a cached write, installation, command execution or task-success receipt for actual host work. The caller/native harness decides whether to use an artifact or execute a script.
requirements.acceptance: A repeated read-only derivation reuses valid work. A prior successful mutation is never replayed, skipped or marked completed by Brain. Reuse records label provenance and validation time.

requirements.title: Versioned positive and negative caches
requirements.requirement: Cache keys shall include scope, source/index epoch, query plan and relevant capability versions. Negative results shall expire or invalidate on new evidence. Cache retention shall be bounded and caching may not preserve access after revocation.
requirements.acceptance: After a miss, add the relevant memory and retrieve it immediately under the documented invalidation contract. Test scope switching, deletions, partial index rebuild and encoder changes.

requirements.title: Portable, progressive skill packages
requirements.requirement: Use Agent Skills-compatible packages where suitable: compact metadata, SKILL.md, and on-demand references/scripts/assets. Preserve existing useful skills. Do not register the entire library into every model prompt; metadata itself has a measurable cost. Support native discovery before inventing a competing skill catalogue.
requirements.acceptance: A relevant skill is found and expanded on demand in two adapters; irrelevant skill instructions are absent. File format validation and total startup metadata costs are recorded.

requirements.title: Native execution, not a Brain workflow engine
requirements.requirement: Procedural memory may produce ordinary scripts, recipes and input/output contracts that the user or native harness executes. Brain shall not implement a second workflow language, execution graph, coordinator, worker pool or retry controller. Static artifact checking and memory applicability checks remain in scope.
requirements.acceptance: Three procedure families—source discovery/inspection, reproducible evidence/test collection, and read-only derivation/report generation—are packaged and exercised through native tooling with explicit dependencies and fewer repeated interpretation steps.

requirements.title: Applicability and unprotected-review honesty
requirements.requirement: Skills shall state prerequisites, supported environments, known failure modes, examples and evidence references. The existing writable review file is not independent approval. Candidate skill text or scripts shall not acquire privileged execution or VERIFIED status through popularity, automatic export or a self-review.
requirements.acceptance: Tamper with review metadata, age dependencies and insert a malicious instruction in a reference. No privileged authority is created; stale applicability is detected or explicitly unknown.

requirements.title: Negative experience and error-triggered help
requirements.requirement: Capture useful corrections, failed assumptions and tool-calling pitfalls as scoped candidate knowledge, not merely success stories. Retrieve a small relevant correction when an error/task cue matches. Avoid permanent global bans derived from a single failed attempt.
requirements.acceptance: A repeat-error workload uses the supported correction and avoids the original mistake, while a changed environment can invalidate it. Compare a concise correction against replaying the full failed transcript.

requirements.title: Selective, provenance-preserving consolidation
requirements.requirement: Consolidation shall merge true duplicates, separate hypotheses from observations, preserve contradictions and extract reusable patterns from permitted evidence. Derived summaries retain source lineage and restrictions. Raw/evidence retention follows explicit policy; a generated summary is never declared mathematically lossless without proof.
requirements.acceptance: Compare pre/post-consolidation answers on exact-fact, current-state, conflict and authorization fixtures. A bad consolidation can be reverted without losing acknowledged source records.

requirements.title: Evidence checking before relying on a learned claim
requirements.requirement: For candidate memories intended to guide repeated work, support targeted read-only verification of relevant source paths, schema, API shape, units or procedure prerequisites. Use existing safe readers and explicit budgets; do not spawn a Brain-owned curator agent. No safe read surface means unsupported/unconfirmed, not guessed evidence.
requirements.acceptance: A plausible but incorrect source locator or schema convention is detected before it is treated as a supported reusable fact. Verification cost and remaining validity scope are recorded separately from authorization.

requirements.title: Learn selectors only when they beat fixed ones
requirements.requirement: Implement an offline comparison of fixed and learned retrieval/cache/consolidation selectors on training and held-out workloads. Deploy the cheapest selector that meets the contract. Learning concerns Brain assistance only, never model/provider routing or host task decisions. Successful empirical learning is desirable; a losing learned approach shall not block V3 if the required outcome is met by a fixed one.
requirements.acceptance: Record a reproducible fixed-policy baseline, holdout results, full training/maintenance cost and promotion/rejection decision. No evaluation leakage, self-reported model-success authority or silent automatic policy promotion.

requirements.title: Bounded maintenance and measured payoff
requirements.requirement: Maintenance and optional model-assisted consolidation shall use explicit limits and be disabled or postponed when unavailable. Account for their cost even when outside the response path. No endless reflection, paid research loop or untracked background work is part of the default runtime.
requirements.acceptance: Run an interrupted/capped maintenance cycle and an idle session. Native work remains unaffected; pending work and dropped optional telemetry are explicit; claimed savings include amortized construction cost.

requirements.title: Budgets by owned data category
requirements.requirement: Track canonical payloads, derived indexes/caches, logs, reports, backups and development artifacts separately. Use content-addressed payload reuse and lossless compression where appropriate. Register byte, age and count budgets for managed categories before promotion; do not claim bounded storage merely because the SQLite file is small.
requirements.acceptance: A growth workload demonstrates accounting and quota behavior for each managed category, including external output/worktree directories when registered. Canonical evidence is not silently deleted to satisfy a cache budget.

requirements.title: Retention, deletion and lineage
requirements.requirement: Retention shall distinguish reclaimable caches from pinned evidence, acknowledged state and recovery snapshots. Deleting/restricting a source shall propagate to dependent views and future retrieval. Already disclosed information cannot be recalled from a host context; report that limitation.
requirements.acceptance: Purge a source and inspect summaries, embeddings, positive/negative caches and later expansion. Live/pinned recovery material remains protected; expiration and deletion receipts identify what was and was not removed.

requirements.title: Safe maintenance and worktree cleanup
requirements.requirement: Only explicitly Brain-managed, disposable artifacts may be automatically reclaimed. Use ownership manifests, dry-run reporting and live-reference checks. Never delete unknown/untracked user files, active worktrees, the active runtime or its only compatible rollback material.
requirements.acceptance: Populate managed/unmanaged files, an active worktree and the reported leftover probe class. Cleanup touches only eligible owned objects. A full quota suppresses optional capture/maintenance, not host task execution.

requirements.title: Measured 16 GB operating envelope
requirements.requirement: Before promoting each profile, freeze numerical RAM, CPU, I/O, disk and maintenance-concurrency budgets on the user's 16 GB system. Include encoders and all Brain processes. Default GPU use is zero; optional semantic resources must unload/degrade according to the declared profile. Budget selection is an M01 deliverable, not an indefinite TBD.
requirements.acceptance: Publish a versioned resource-profile manifest before holdout evaluation. Test native host co-use, cold load, idle, indexing and memory-pressure cases. Reject budget overruns rather than silently changing limits after seeing results.

requirements.title: No authority laundering
requirements.requirement: Preserve M00 refusals throughout create/search/merge/resolve/list/curate/consolidate/export/context paths. Agent-written approval, model-success claims, claimed VERIFIED grades and writable skill-review records remain non-authoritative. Facts, remembered user instructions and evidence references do not mint current permission.
requirements.acceptance: Carry an unauthorized claim through repeated merges, summaries, retrievals and exports; it cannot become VERIFIED, project policy or critical completion authority. Preserve effective/claimed label separation everywhere.

requirements.title: Prompt-injection and metadata tests
requirements.requirement: Treat retrieved content, tool outputs, filenames, project names and source metadata as untrusted data. Frame and escape them, preserve provenance and source role, and prevent them from altering scope/tool capability decisions. Framing alone is not a security guarantee; test downstream behavior and enforce data boundaries outside generated text.
requirements.acceptance: Test direct and indirect injection, malicious names, quoted instructions, summary contamination and persistent poisoning in real hook/output paths. No source may expand its own permissions or execute a skill by being retrieved.

requirements.title: Explicit disclosure and sharing
requirements.requirement: Cloud exports, Git commits of memory and cross-project shared packs shall be explicit, curated and traceable. Do not copy the entire live store or assume a private repository makes all content suitable for upload. Core local operation must not upload prompts, embeddings or memory without authorization.
requirements.acceptance: Inspect outgoing requests and export manifests. A local-only profile performs no memory egress; excluded/private records are absent from exported packs and derived summaries.

requirements.title: Integrity is not independent authentication
requirements.requirement: Unsigned chains/checksums shall be described as integrity mechanisms under their stated assumptions, not independent proof against a same-user attacker who can rewrite state and validation code. External issuer/custody/signing remain separate. No test suite or second model is itself an external root of trust.
requirements.acceptance: Reports distinguish tested integrity checks from protected signatures and identify trust assumptions. Authority remains unavailable until separately qualified; no V3 acceptance claim quietly upgrades that status.

requirements.title: Two real hosts, shared semantics
requirements.requirement: Qualify OMP and one additional existing local harness against the same core memory/retrieval contracts. Support Windows as the primary environment and exercise platform-neutral components on Linux. A cloud adapter is optional and not a release-start gate.
requirements.acceptance: Use real sessions for at least two hosts with positive memory delivery, Brain-off controls, scope isolation, refusal preservation and unaffected native delegation. Adapter omissions are reported, not covered by simulated-host tests alone.

requirements.title: One runtime identity per active integration
requirements.requirement: Bind every active entrypoint to the intended runtime and schema. Detect canonical-venv/environment-variable mismatches, stale plugins, gateways requiring restart and old hooks. Qualification shall enumerate actual entrypoints rather than assume an environment variable affects every host.
requirements.acceptance: Invoke the real CLI, hooks and plugin entrypoints and record imported source identity. A mixed old/new runtime is detected; a gateway restart is evidenced when required.

requirements.title: Interoperate without protocol overreach
requirements.requirement: Expose small stable memory/search/expand/skill interfaces through native hooks or standards-based adapters as supported. Agent Skills compatibility is useful now; MCP extensions require capability negotiation and actual host support. New protocol task/orchestration features do not authorize Brain task management.
requirements.acceptance: Unsupported extension capabilities cleanly fall back or remain unavailable. The adapter adds no forbidden lifecycle control and no unused global tool surface in the strict no-op profile.

requirements.title: Current-state-safe upgrade and recovery
requirements.requirement: Migration, backups and rollback shall preserve the latest acknowledged work. Keep derived index migration separate from canonical schema migration. Prefer forward repair or a compatible M00-based recovery path over restoring an old vulnerable runtime; label any emergency security regression explicitly.
requirements.acceptance: Rehearse upgrade and failure on disposable production-like copies, then bind live acceptance to the same bytes when authorized. Recovery does not silently discard post-backup memory or reinstate SEC-AUTH authority.

requirements.title: Strong matched controls
requirements.requirement: Compare native host, inert Brain adapter, activated M00 baseline and V3 candidate with matched model, effort, tools and data. Where relevant and available, include the host's native memory/skills configuration as a strong control rather than an artificially impoverished baseline.
requirements.acceptance: Each report includes configuration fingerprints, source/corpus snapshots, randomization/order, all failures and cold/warm/cache conditions. Do not compare a better model in the candidate to a weaker model in the control.

requirements.title: End-to-end and multi-session workloads
requirements.requirement: Evaluate real developer tasks across Brain, BasicUpscaler and SZ-tools/Telemetry, plus synthetic controlled cases. Include multi-session state changes, changed dependencies, exact IDs, prompt dilution, no-benefit turns, repeat corrections, compaction, cross-project denial and missing sources.
requirements.acceptance: Publish held-out task families and memory queries before promotion. Measure correct task completion, current-state accuracy, repeat-mistake rate, evidence coverage, total tokens/time and resources, not only retrieval recall or unit-test count.

requirements.title: Diagnose the failing stage
requirements.requirement: Separate capture/construction loss, stale-state resolution, query/candidate retrieval, reranking/packing and model interpretation. Use explicit gold-evidence and raw-source diagnostic controls where feasible. Do not respond to every retrieval failure by adding a larger encoder.
requirements.acceptance: For a failed case, compare normal retrieval, known correct stored evidence and raw evidence under a fixed reader. The report identifies which stage the intervention implicates without claiming a universal causal proof.

requirements.title: Predeclared gates and independent review
requirements.requirement: Freeze benchmark snapshots, resource limits, quality margins and material-improvement thresholds before evaluating held-out results. Deterministic security, source-validity and acknowledged-state fixtures must all pass. Evaluate stochastic task results with appropriate uncertainty and changed-path independent review.
requirements.acceptance: No post-hoc removal of failing cases, relaxed threshold or suppressed startup cost. Zero observed failures is reported as a tested result, not proof that future failures are impossible.

requirements.title: Finite V3 boundary
requirements.requirement: V3 requires useful retrieval, current-state memory, safe reuse, faithful continuity, portable host-executed skills, selective consolidation, bounded resources and demonstrated net benefit under shipping defaults. Optional techniques receive a disposition: promoted, rejected, deferred or blocked. A named algorithm losing a comparison does not create a new prerequisite module.
requirements.acceptance: The final matrix maps every core requirement to code/evidence or a stated unmet condition. No unchecked core outcome is relabeled optional merely to declare completion, and no new paper automatically reopens scope.

acceptance_cases.name: True no-benefit turn
acceptance_cases.given: Matched native/inert/M00/V3 configurations; unrelated arithmetic or direct text task.
acceptance_cases.when: Run repeated cold and warm requests and capture model-facing payloads.
acceptance_cases.then: Zero additional Brain payload/schema/calls; whole-turn latency gates met.

acceptance_cases.name: Meaning-equivalent prompt dilution
acceptance_cases.given: Known relevant memory plus hard negatives.
acceptance_cases.when: Compare concise task with the same task surrounded by long instructions, logs and code.
acceptance_cases.then: The required source remains discoverable; no assumption that every long prompt is equivalent.

acceptance_cases.name: A real appended constraint
acceptance_cases.given: Two memories distinguished by OS, version or time scope.
acceptance_cases.when: Append a genuine new constraint to an otherwise matching prompt.
acceptance_cases.then: Retrieval respects the changed intent instead of blindly copying the concise-query result.

acceptance_cases.name: Source move and uncommitted edit
acceptance_cases.given: Known source locator and derived result.
acceptance_cases.when: Move/edit relevant tracked or untracked content without changing HEAD.
acceptance_cases.then: Dependencies invalidate; locator or evidence is refreshed; stale exact answer is not returned.

acceptance_cases.name: Current versus historical decision
acceptance_cases.given: A decision, reversal and late-arriving older note.
acceptance_cases.when: Ask current and as-of questions, including the removal of orchestration.
acceptance_cases.then: Supported current and historical answers differ correctly; unresolved contradictions stay explicit.

acceptance_cases.name: Derived cross-project leak
acceptance_cases.given: Restricted project source summarized into a nominally shared record.
acceptance_cases.when: Search and expand from another project, then revoke source access after warming caches.
acceptance_cases.then: Original and derived restricted content/metadata are not disclosed.

acceptance_cases.name: Authority through transformations
acceptance_cases.when: Merge, summarize, curate, package as a skill, export and retrieve repeatedly.
acceptance_cases.then: No independent authority is created at any step; claimed and effective status remain distinct.

acceptance_cases.name: Five-round compaction and restart
acceptance_cases.given: Exact IDs, commands, numbers, active constraints, stale and hostile quoted content.
acceptance_cases.when: Perform five projection/recovery rounds and a real host compaction/restart where supported.
acceptance_cases.then: Required source-backed details are recoverable under the declared contract; no host veto/forced continuation.

acceptance_cases.name: Encoder migration
acceptance_cases.given: Two encoders with the same output dimensionality but incompatible spaces.
acceptance_cases.when: Mix versions deliberately and interrupt new-index construction.
acceptance_cases.then: Mixed-space retrieval is refused/isolated; coherent old or new profile remains available.

acceptance_cases.name: Absent Brain component
acceptance_cases.given: Fresh native session and bounded optional hooks.
acceptance_cases.when: Break interpreter/index/model availability and cause database contention.
acceptance_cases.then: Native work remains usable; explicit queries report unavailable; permissions do not weaken.

acceptance_cases.name: Native delegation and completion
acceptance_cases.given: Fresh OMP plus one second-host session.
acceptance_cases.when: Delegate a native child and end/stop normally, including unfinished advisory notes.
acceptance_cases.then: Brain does not block, continue, retry, route or settle host work.

acceptance_cases.name: Negative-cache invalidation
acceptance_cases.when: Add relevant evidence, then query without restarting the entire host.
acceptance_cases.then: New evidence is visible according to the documented invalidation contract.

acceptance_cases.name: Reusable artifact versus cached side effect
acceptance_cases.given: Prior read-only derivation and separate prior mutating command receipt.
acceptance_cases.when: Request the derivation again and present the prior mutation as a candidate shortcut.
acceptance_cases.then: Safe artifact reuse is possible; no mutation execution or completion is inferred by Brain.

acceptance_cases.name: Correction actually helps
acceptance_cases.given: A reproducible prior error and supported correction.
acceptance_cases.when: Run held-out analogous tasks and an environment where the old correction no longer applies.
acceptance_cases.then: Fewer repeated errors without stale global overgeneralization.

acceptance_cases.name: Quota and retention stress
acceptance_cases.given: Managed caches/reports, pinned evidence, an active worktree and unknown user files.
acceptance_cases.when: Exceed registered quotas, delete a source and interrupt cleanup.
acceptance_cases.then: Owned expendable data is reclaimed safely; derived disclosures are removed; unknown/pinned/live data survives.

acceptance_cases.name: Knowledge verification
acceptance_cases.given: A plausible false schema/path/unit claim extracted from a successful trajectory.
acceptance_cases.when: Use safe bounded source checks, then run with the source inaccessible.
acceptance_cases.then: False claim is narrowed/rejected; inaccessible evidence remains unconfirmed, not self-approved.

acceptance_cases.name: Cross-model and cross-host memory
acceptance_cases.given: Equivalent structured memories plus raw evidence from one writer.
acceptance_cases.when: Use a second reader/model and host; distinguish semantic interpretation from embedding migration.
acceptance_cases.then: Exact facts remain accessible and failures are diagnosed by stage; no claimed universal model independence.

acceptance_cases.name: All-in learning economics
acceptance_cases.given: Fixed and learned selectors; training/validation/held-out splits.
acceptance_cases.when: Measure construction, maintenance and multiple later tasks with paired controls.
acceptance_cases.then: Promotion depends on net benefit and quality, not only task-agent savings or self-reported success.

notes: Acceptance cases are test specifications, not executable tests or completed evidence.
Every core requirement also has its own acceptance text, including requirements not named by an example case.
Actual runtime/corpus/resource fingerprints must be supplied by the implementing agent before evaluating the candidate.
External signing/approval and Claude cloud remain outside the local V3 start gate.
